map.Child-Pugh A 级就能安全手术吗？: Is grade A safe for surgery?
map.A 级提示肝功能储备较好，可耐受大多数择期手术，但仍需结合白蛋白、凝血酶原活动度: Grade A indicates good hepatic functional reserve and tolerance for most elective surgeries, but albumin, prothrombin activity, and nutritional status must still be assessed together. In grade C (≥10 points) major-surgery mortality rises markedly, so usually only emergency lifesaving surgery or transplant evaluation is performed.
